name: jev-browser-ultrafast

tests.live_canary: pass: example.com -> IANA, 1 click, done, 4115 ms, central_jev_guarded=true, independent_outcome_verified=true

central_governance: per-action JEV Central Gateway PreTool/PostTool on 127.0.0.1:4110
capability_lease: initial hostname by default; explicit --allow-host required for cross-domain
stale_policy: discard stale decision, re-observe, predict again
rollback: Disable jev-browser-ultrafast in JEV Skill Steward, remove its surface symlinks, and leave the pinned upstream checkout inert.
decision_backend: TypeSafe System One https://api.typesafe.ai/v1/systemone, model jev-latest
completion_policy: independent acceptance evidence checked before requesting another action; mutation thresholds unchanged
